values.note: Tight space for vehicles; 30-ft maximum. Two vehicles or one RV (with its tow vehicle) per site included.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/springdale-campground ('This campground has 13 sites ... There is tight space for vehicles with a maximum limit of 30 feet.'), read 2026-10-28

hookups.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/springdale-campground ('This is a standard, nonelectric campground.'; 'Potable water is not available at this site.') + recreation.gov catalog (4 Scan and Pay sites, STANDARD NONELECTRIC, Water Hookup 'No'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Late May to early September, depending on weather.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/springdale-campground ('The campground is open late May to early September, depending on weather conditions.'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: First come, first served; no reservations. Pay at the self-service fee tube (cash, check or money order) or with the recreation.gov app's Scan and Pay; a site must be occupied the same night. Check-in 2 p.m., check-out noon.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/springdale-campground ('This is a first-come, first-served campground; reservations are not available.'; 'Fees are payable by cash, check or money order. A self-service fee tube is available.'; 'First-come, first-served sites must be occupied the same night') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10165671 (first-come, first-served only, Scan and Pay), read 2026-10-28

values.note: $25 a site (two vehicles or one RV included); third vehicle $11 on the FS page, $10 on recreation.gov; day use $11.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/springdale-campground ('$25 fee per site for overnight camping ... $11 fee for a third vehicle.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10165671/rates (First-come, First-served Season 2026-05-22 to 2026-09-06: 25; 2027 the same) and notice ('$10.00 for a third vehicle'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: 50% off the site the pass holder occupies (concessionaire-run).

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/springdale-campground ('The Interagency Senior Pass and the Interagency Access Pass qualify for a 50% discount at concessionaire-run campsites.'), read 2026-10-28

note: Pike NF (Pikes Peak RD) on gravel Rampart Range Rd (FR 300), 1.7 mi east of Woodland Park and 3.5 mi from the Rampart Reservoir Recreation Area, ~9,300 ft; sites on a wooded spur east of the road. --Claude
